Subject: You can watch Den on Plex

Den is shared with your Plex account gracehopper. To watch:

1. Get the Plex app
2. Sign in as gracehopper
3. Pick Den

Your SlipStream PIN doesn't work in Plex.

Open the email from Plex and accept the share.

SlipStream sends this when an Admin shares a server with your Plex account.
